name: Coldbreak Ventflow Cargo Short
description: Knee-length cargo shorts in recycled synth-canvas, dusty olive with heat-sealed mesh side panels that vent thigh heat during humid stretches. Four zippered pockets, one with a hidden conductive sleeve for cooling leg-prosthetic contact points. Adjustable waistband fits over hip chrome without pinching.
functionality: Mesh side vents for air circulation, conductive prosthetic-cooling sleeve, aug-compatible waistband.
what_it_says: Function over everything — you've sweated through enough bad shorts to stop caring how they look.
story_hooks: The conductive sleeve was retrofitted by a street augtech — it runs cooler than the factory spec, but why?
A cargo pocket is stitched shut from the inside, something lumpy and uncuttable sealed within.

physical_description.visual_profile: Utilitarian knee-length cargo shorts with a relaxed, athletic silhouette. The dusty olive base reads as practical streetwear, elevated by technical mesh paneling that catches light along the thighs. Design suggests function-first ethos without sacrificing movement or style.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through hip and thigh with tapered calf opening. Waistband engineered wide and smooth to accommodate hip-mounted chrome without binding or chafing. Allows full range of motion for urban navigation.
physical_description.primary_material: Recycled synth-canvas—durable, weather-resistant composite woven from post-consumer synthetics. Paired with heat-sealed ballistic mesh side panels for airflow and thermal regulation.
physical_description.texture: Canvas has a subtle weave with slight surface irregularity; mesh panels are smooth and slightly tacky to touch, designed for friction-grip during perspiration. Heat-seal seams are visible but clean, no fraying.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dusty olive primary with charcoal-gray heat-sealed mesh panels along thighs. Subtle tonal variation suggests age and wear resistance built into the dye.
physical_description.closures: Four external zippered cargo pockets with reinforced teeth. Main waistband uses dual friction-fit magnetic snaps paired with a discreet side-buckle adjustment—allows customization without traditional belt loops.
distinctive_features: Heat-sealed mesh vent panels on outer thighs for passive thermal management
Hidden conductive sleeve lining inside left thigh pocket—designed to interface safely with prosthetic cooling nodes
Reinforced stress points at knee and crotch seam
Subtle Coldbreak embossed logo on right cargo pocket flap
Grommet drainage holes at hem corners
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional wear. Price point and material quality suggest working-class or lower-mid corpo tech workers, not luxury but intentionally engineered.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented laborers, field technicians, logistics operators, and anyone managing heat and mobility in the humid GLMZ sprawl. Signals practical competence and acceptance of bodily modification.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but maintained. Canvas softens with wear; mesh panels show minor pilling. Conductive sleeve occasionally exhibits faint discoloration from repeated prosthetic contact. Zippers remain functional.
